versions.changelog:
jimeng-video v2.0.0 – Now supports generating videos with audio!

- Default model upgraded to `doubao-seedance-1-5-pro-251215`, producing videos with automatic sound (background music, sound effects, ambience)
- Added support for both text-to-video and image-to-video with audio
- Expanded documentation with usage examples, prompt tips for audio, and model comparisons
- Batch generation and task management features improved
- Detailed API usage, configuration, troubleshooting, and scenario guides added
